caseSelection.perActorPerTask: For each ON/OFF and task, chronological first deferral-change case; if none first same-frame retry after other frames; if none first immediate same-frame retry; if none first ABAB or initial explored route. Never select by goal outcome.
caseSelection.additional: First remaining model-origin ABAB and first remaining policy-involved ABAB, maximum6 distinct cases. Inspect up to12 current/next actual actor PNGs, missing next input explicit; terminal audit is not a delivered model observation.

questions: What did the model propose versus what did the sampler execute?
What visible information or alternative exploration preceded a revisit?
Which outcome/history was actually supplied, and is forgetting unproven?
Does a current expectation have observation support or remain a model hypothesis?
Does the controller create a local action substitution and subsequent observed alternation? Do not infer an unexecuted whole trajectory.
decisionRules: Do not rank naturalness from task success.
Do not call a correct-control bypass or a revisit abnormal by itself.
Report plausible unsuccessful exploration alongside concerns.
If code changes or loses required information/safety or silently substitutes actions, fix the demonstrated implementation issue and reverify.

Keep uncalibrated optimization weights explicitly distinguishable from user-motion observations; recommend inspectable no-reweighting mode when studying model-selected motion, without claiming human fidelity.
stopOrReplace: Preserve failure and missing; no replacement runs.
